player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between the Wine cellar and the Exercise room, repeatedly moving west and east without exploring other potential directions. Worse, I declared "DONE" prematurely while unvisited rooms were still reachable. Next time, I will strictly track visited nodes and only output "DONE" when the set of visited nodes equals the total number of unique rooms discovered. If I encounter a room where all current directions lead back to already visited nodes, I will check if there are any unvisited neighbors in the available directions before deciding to stop. I will also ensure the graph edges are updated correctly to reflect the bidirectional nature of the movement (e.g., if I go from A to B, the edge should appear in both A's and B's perspective if the format requires it, or at least ensure the path is recorded accurately). Specifically, from the Exercise room, instead of immediately going back east, I should have checked if "west" or "east" led to new rooms; since I was back in the start, I should have realized I was looping and perhaps the game master would have offered a new direction if I had explored further, but since the options were limited, I must ensure I don't stop until the graph is fully connected or no new nodes can be found. Actually, looking at the history, I only visited 2 rooms. The mistake was stopping too early. I will continue moving until I have visited all possible rooms indicated by the game master's hints or until I am certain no new rooms exist.
